_comment: Emulator configuration for the native adapter check only.
Separate from Web/firebase/firebase.json for two reasons. It loads
adapter.rules rather than the shipped firestore.rules — see the comment in
that file for why the adapter check runs unauthenticated — and it uses
different ports, so a native check and a rules check can run at the same
time without one silently answering the other's requests.
No project of its own: the project id begins with `demo-`, which the CLI
treats as offline-only and never reaches the network for.
Auth is not started. The check does not sign in, and starting an emulator
nothing talks to would only invite the mistake of assuming it did.
